brief.meaningEn: The product benefits most likely to persuade the intended buyer.
brief.meaningZh: 對目標買家最有說服力的產品優點。
brief.grammar: Pattern: a/the strongest selling point(s) of + product or plan. One of the strongest selling points takes a plural noun; a singular point names one benefit.
brief.register: Neutral product-comparison or sales language: a salesperson or reviewer tells a buyer which specific benefits make an item appealing to that buyer.
brief.boundaryZh: 賣點是能影響選擇的優點；不是每個規格都同樣有說服力，也不等同保證銷量。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不要把 selling points 理解為實際銷售地點或價格本身；應說清楚好處。
brief.outcomeZh: 能指出產品的一項具體優點，以及它為何打動合適買家。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 26, row 4; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: Low maintenance is one of the strongest selling points of the new bicycle.

listening.en: The new bicycle needs little maintenance, which matters to commuters who ride every day. That low upkeep is one of its strongest selling points.
listening.zh: 這款新單車不太需要維修，對每天騎車上班的人很重要。低保養需求是它最有說服力的賣點之一。
listening.promptZh: 為何低保養需求是 strongest selling point？

options.en: It solves an important concern for regular commuters.
options.zh: 它解決了經常騎車通勤者重視的問題。

options.en: The bicycle has several frame colours, so its colour choices must matter most to commuters concerned about repairs.
options.zh: 單車有多種車架顏色可選，所以顏色必定是重視維修問題的通勤者最在意的特點。

options.en: It means every commuter will buy the bicycle.
options.zh: 它表示每位通勤者都會買這款單車。

options.en: It tells us where the bicycle can be sold.
options.zh: 它告訴我們單車可在哪裏出售。

listening.explanationZh: 低保養需求直接回應經常騎車者的顧慮；顏色選擇不能單憑存在便成為他們最重視的賣點，更不保證人人購買。

reply.promptEn: Why might parents choose this reusable lunch box for their children?
reply.promptZh: （家長為何可能為子女選擇這款可重用飯盒？）

options.en: Its sealed lid helps stop food leaking into a school bag.
options.zh: 密封蓋有助防止食物漏進書包。

options.en: It can be washed easily after school.
options.zh: 放學後容易清洗。

options.en: One of its strongest selling points is a leakproof lid that suits school bags.
options.zh: 它最有說服力的賣點之一，是適合放進書包的防漏蓋。

options.en: Its size leaves room for other books in a bag.
options.zh: 它的尺寸讓書包仍有空間放其他書。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都提出對家長有用的具體理由；金句明確指出能打動家長的賣點。

options.en: The tested leakproof lid is one of its strongest selling points for students.
options.zh: 經測試的防漏蓋是對學生最有說服力的賣點之一。

options.en: Its bright colour may be pleasant, but it does not address the stated concern about leaks.
options.zh: 顏色鮮艷或許討喜，卻沒有解決題目所說的漏汁問題。

options.en: The package lists many features without explaining whether any prevent leaks.
options.zh: 包裝列出許多特點，卻沒有說明哪項能防漏。

scene.explanationZh: 防漏蓋直接回應學生的主要顧慮，所以特別有說服力；顏色和未解釋的規格較不切題。
scene.promptZh: 學生要帶飯盒上學，最怕湯汁漏到書本。新飯盒有經測試的防漏蓋。哪句最貼切？

options.en: A secure lid helps keep soup away from school books.
options.zh: 牢固的蓋子有助避免湯汁沾到課本。

options.en: The lid has a small decorative mark that does not affect use and most buyers would not notice.
options.zh: 蓋上有一個不影響使用、買家大多不會留意的小裝飾記號。

options.en: The box is easy to clean after a school day.
options.zh: 飯盒在上學一天後容易清洗。

contrast.explanationZh: 不影響使用、也少有人在意的裝飾細節，難成為最有說服力的賣點；防漏和易清洗才回應家長需要。
contrast.promptZh: 哪個描述最不適合作為這款飯盒針對家長的 strongest selling point？

options.en: They should explain the strongest selling points for you, such as low repair costs and easy maintenance.
options.zh: 他們應介紹對你最有說服力的賣點，例如維修費低、容易保養。

options.en: The bell colour may matter to some buyers, so you should choose by colour alone.
options.zh: 車鈴顏色可能對部分買家重要，因此你應只按顏色選擇。

options.en: Ask the shop to list every part of the bicycle without explaining its value.
options.zh: 請店舖列出單車每個零件，卻不用解釋用途。

dialogue.explanationZh: 朋友重視價格和維修，回應應把相關好處連到他的需要，而非只談無關裝飾或堆砌規格。
dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「我想買一個便宜又易維修的單車；店員只談車鈴顏色。」你怎樣回應較貼切？

speaking.en: For busy parents, the lunch box’s easy-clean lid is one of its strongest selling points.
speaking.zh: 對忙碌家長而言，飯盒容易清洗的蓋子是最有說服力的賣點之一。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再指出優點為何對目標買家重要。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：社區書店推出可重用購物袋，袋底加固且可摺起來放進手袋。常買重書的顧客重視承重和易攜。用一至兩句英文寫一則適合他們的簡短推介。
writing.selfCheckZh: 指出加固袋底或易摺好攜帶，並說明為何能吸引常買重書的顧客；不要保證每個人都會買。

examples.en: A reinforced base is one of the bag’s strongest selling points for customers who carry heavy books; the bag also folds into a handbag.
examples.zh: 對常帶重書的顧客而言，加固袋底是袋子最有說服力的賣點之一；它還可摺好放進手袋。

examples.en: For readers buying heavy books, easy folding and a sturdy bottom are the bag’s strongest selling points because it is simple to carry and strong enough for their purchases.
examples.zh: 對購買重書的讀者來說，容易摺起來和結實的袋底是這款袋子最有說服力的賣點，因為它易攜帶，也能承重。

takeaways.en: A quiet motor is one of the strongest selling points for people in small flats.
takeaways.zh: 對住在小單位的人而言，寧靜馬達是最有說服力的賣點之一。

takeaways.en: A useful feature becomes a key selling point when it answers a buyer’s real concern.
takeaways.zh: 有用的功能若回應買家的實際顧慮，就會成為主要賣點。

notes: AI-authored provisional draft; independent English, Chinese, media and QA review remain pending.

brief.meaningEn: Be supplied with many features or items as part of the product.
brief.meaningZh: 產品交付時已配備或預載許多功能、內容或物品。
brief.grammar: Pattern: come/comes/came loaded with + included features or resources. The subject is a product or service, and with introduces what is supplied.
brief.register: Informal product description: a seller or reviewer tells a potential buyer which features are included, without implying that the product is physically heavy.
brief.boundaryZh: 本課強調產品本身已附帶多項功能；日後另購配件或只容許安裝，不等於交付時已配備。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不要把 loaded 誤解為貨物很重，也不要以為任何單一基本功能都足以稱 loaded with。
brief.outcomeZh: 能說明產品交付時已包含哪些具體功能。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 26, row 7; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: The new apartment will come loaded with smart controls.

listening.en: The new library tablet comes loaded with an offline dictionary, audio instructions and large-text settings. Visitors can use all three without installing anything.
listening.zh: 新圖書館平板已預載離線字典、語音指示和大字設定。訪客無須安裝便可使用這三項功能。
listening.promptZh: comes loaded with 在這裏表示甚麼？

options.en: Several useful features are already included on the tablet.
options.zh: 平板本身已包含多項實用功能。

options.en: The tablet is heavy because its battery is large.
options.zh: 平板因電池大而很重。

options.en: Visitors must purchase each feature separately later.
options.zh: 訪客其後要逐項購買功能。

options.en: The tablet can accept extra apps, but none is installed yet.
options.zh: 平板可加裝程式，但目前尚未安裝任何功能。

listening.explanationZh: 離線字典等功能交付時已備妥，不是實物重量或日後另購。

reply.promptEn: What makes the new library tablet useful to first-time visitors?
reply.promptZh: （新圖書館平板對首次來訪者有甚麼幫助？）

options.en: Its offline dictionary lets them check unfamiliar words.
options.zh: 離線字典讓他們查不熟悉的詞語。

options.en: The audio guide can explain where the main collections are.
options.zh: 語音指南可說明主要館藏在哪裏。

options.en: It comes loaded with a dictionary, audio guide and large-text mode.
options.zh: 它已預載字典、語音指南及大字模式。

options.en: The adjustable text makes instructions easier to read.
options.zh: 可調字體令指示更易閱讀。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都提出平板已具備的實際幫助；金句概括產品預載多項功能。

options.en: The camera comes loaded with useful shooting and backup features.
options.zh: 相機本身已配備多項拍攝及備份功能。

options.en: The camera can accept these features later if the centre buys add-ons.
options.zh: 中心日後若購買附加功能，相機便可使用它們。

options.en: The camera is packed in a heavy case, but its features have not been checked.
options.zh: 相機裝在很重的盒裏，但功能尚未核實。

scene.explanationZh: 夜拍、防震及備份開箱已可用，符合預載多項功能；日後添購或盒重不同。
scene.promptZh: 社區中心買了一部新相機。開箱即可使用夜拍、防震和自動備份，毋須另購或安裝。哪句最貼切？

options.en: A reading device arrives with several dictionaries and voice tools ready to use.
options.zh: 閱讀器交付時已備有幾本字典和語音工具。

options.en: A basic speaker has no extra features until users buy a separate service next month.
options.zh: 基本喇叭沒有額外功能，使用者下月另購服務後才有。

options.en: A new camera includes editing, backup and low-light modes from the start.
options.zh: 新相機一開始就具備剪輯、備份及低光模式。

contrast.explanationZh: 功能尚未包含、要日後另購，不能說交付時已 loaded with；其餘兩項已內建多種功能。
contrast.promptZh: 哪個情況最不適合用 come loaded with 描述產品交付時的功能？

options.en: It comes loaded with those features already, so you can try them before installing anything else.
options.zh: 它本身已配備這些功能，你可先試用，毋須加裝其他東西。

options.en: You can probably buy those features later, even though they are already on the projector.
options.zh: 雖然投影機已有這些功能，你大概仍可日後再購買。

options.en: The case must be heavy if it has that many menu options.
options.zh: 選單功能多，外箱一定很重。

dialogue.explanationZh: 朋友強調開箱即可使用多項功能，表示已內建；不是將來另購或外箱重量。
dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「這部投影機一開箱就有字幕、無線連接和自動調焦，還要裝甚麼嗎？」你怎樣回應最貼切？

speaking.en: The reader comes loaded with language guides and audio controls that work offline.
speaking.zh: 這款閱讀器已預載語言指南及可離線使用的語音控制功能。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說明哪些功能在交付時已包含。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：社區中心新設一部電子資訊站，開機即可使用多語言指南、語音指示與大字模式。用一至兩句英文向訪客介紹已包含的功能。
writing.selfCheckZh: 指出功能在開機時已備妥，並具體提及多語言指南、語音指示與大字模式；不要寫成日後另購。

examples.en: The new information kiosk comes loaded with multilingual guides, audio directions and a large-text mode that visitors can use immediately.
examples.zh: 新的電子資訊站已預載多語言指南、語音指示和大字模式，訪客可立即使用。

examples.en: Visitors can start at once because the centre’s kiosk comes loaded with language guides, spoken instructions and large-text settings.
examples.zh: 訪客可即時開始使用，因為中心的資訊站已預載語言指南、語音指示及大字設定。

takeaways.en: The camera comes loaded with editing tools that are ready on day one.
takeaways.zh: 相機交付時已配備可立即使用的剪輯工具。

takeaways.en: The new display came loaded with accessibility settings at no extra cost.
takeaways.zh: 新顯示器已預載無障礙設定，毋須額外付費。

notes: AI-authored provisional draft; independent English, Chinese, media and QA review remain pending.

lessons.titleEn: a brilliant servant, but a poor master
lessons.titleZh: 出色的僕人，拙劣的主人

brief.meaningEn: Money or a tool can help when people direct it, but can harm when allowed to govern their choices.
brief.meaningZh: 金錢或工具受人主導時可以幫上忙；若反過來支配人的選擇，便可能帶來傷害。
brief.grammar: Pattern: X is/can be a good or brilliant servant, but a poor master. The source uses good with money; the original lesson uses brilliant with technology. Keep the two count-noun complements and their articles; X names the resource or tool being directed.
brief.register: Reflective advice about control: a person may value money or a tool for what it enables while resisting its power to dictate priorities. In the original technology case, a community organiser advises a fellow volunteer to check a translation-app draft.
brief.boundaryZh: 此比喻可用於金錢或工具：有用不等於應讓它支配家庭生活或判斷；不是說金錢或機器真的變成僕人或主人。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不要把賺錢、儲蓄或使用工具本身當成錯；關鍵是人是否仍按真正需要作出選擇。
brief.outcomeZh: 能說出金錢或工具如何幫助人，以及它何時開始不恰當地主導人的選擇。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 27, row 6; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: Technology can be a brilliant servant, but a poor master.
sources.expression: a brilliant servant, but a poor master

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 40, row 8; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: My grandfather believed money is a good servant, but a poor master in family life.
sources.expression: money is a good servant, but a poor master

listening.en: A budgeting app helped Noor spot waste, but its strict limits made her skip necessary groceries. She revised them around her needs: the app was a brilliant servant, but a poor master.
listening.zh: 理財程式幫娜兒發現浪費，但程式建議的嚴格限額令她連必需食材也不買。她按自己的需要調整限額：程式是出色的僕人，卻是拙劣的主人。
listening.promptZh: 這句話在娜兒使用理財程式時指甚麼？

options.en: The app helped her spot waste, but its suggested limits should not override her essential needs.
options.zh: 程式幫她找出浪費，但建議的限額不應凌駕她的基本需要。

options.en: The suggested limits were helpful, so she should keep them even when they leave no money for necessary groceries.
options.zh: 建議限額既然有用，即使令她無錢買必需食材，也應照用。

options.en: Because one limit was unsuitable, the spending information the app provides has no value.
options.zh: 有一項限額不合適，便表示程式提供的開支資料毫無價值。

options.en: The main problem was that Noor bought groceries before reviewing the app’s spending categories.
options.zh: 主要問題是娜兒在檢視程式的開支分類前買了食材。

listening.explanationZh: 程式指出浪費有幫助，但她曾盲從建議限額，犧牲基本需要；調整限額表示她重新掌握決定權。

reply.promptEn: How should we use a homework planning app without letting it decide our whole week?
reply.promptZh: （我們應如何使用功課規劃程式，同時不讓它決定整個星期？）

options.en: Use its reminders, but choose our own priorities and rest times.
options.zh: 使用提醒功能，但自行決定優先次序與休息時間。

options.en: Review its suggestions before moving family or study plans.
options.zh: 更改家庭或溫習計劃前，先檢視它的建議。

options.en: It can be a brilliant servant, but a poor master; let it remind us without obeying every suggestion.
options.zh: 它可以是出色的僕人，卻是拙劣的主人；讓它提醒我們，卻不用盲從每項建議。

options.en: Keep a way to adjust the schedule when our needs change.
options.zh: 需要改變時，保留自行調整時間表的方法。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都提出既利用工具又保留自主決定的做法；金句以僕人與主人比喻概括界線。

options.en: Money can be a good servant, but a poor master: paying off debt helped, yet chasing a higher balance need not dictate every family hour.
options.zh: 金錢可以是好僕人，卻是差主人：還清債務有幫助，但追求更高存款不必支配每段家庭時間。

options.en: The extra shifts paid off debt, so the lost family time cannot be a cost.
options.zh: 加班還清了債，所以失去的家庭時間不可能是代價。

options.en: The lost family time proves that earning money to repay the debt was never useful.
options.zh: 失去家庭時間證明賺錢還債從來沒有用處。

scene.explanationZh: 加班還債有實際幫助；若只為增加存款便放棄所有相聚時間，金錢就開始反過來支配生活。另兩項各忽略了一面。
scene.promptZh: 麗娜多接班還清了債，現在卻為了讓存款數字繼續上升，連每週與家人吃飯的時間也全數放棄。哪句評語最能同時看到金錢的幫助和它對生活的支配？

options.en: A student uses an app’s reminder but chooses when to take a break.
options.zh: 學生使用程式提醒，仍自行決定何時休息。

options.en: A device schedules every meal and refuses changes even when family plans shift.
options.zh: 裝置安排每餐時間，即使家庭計劃改變也不容修改。

options.en: A recommendation system keeps pushing choices even after users reject them.
options.zh: 推薦系統在使用者拒絕後仍不斷推送選項。

contrast.explanationZh: 學生仍自己決定，工具只是協助，未出現反客為主；另外兩項限制或無視使用者選擇。
contrast.promptZh: 哪個情況最不適合用 a brilliant servant, but a poor master 警告工具反客為主？

options.en: It can be a brilliant servant, but a poor master; use the light correction, but decide yourself which details belong in the picture.
options.zh: 它可以是出色的僕人，卻是拙劣的主人；可用它調光，但照片該保留甚麼細節，仍要自己決定。

options.en: The light correction helped, so its cropping suggestion must also preserve the picture’s meaning.
options.zh: 調光既然有幫助，裁剪建議也必定能保留照片的原意。

options.en: Because one crop was misleading, the tool cannot help with any part of the editing.
options.zh: 一次裁剪造成誤導，這工具便不能協助任何修圖工作。

dialogue.explanationZh: 調光功能有用，但裁剪會改變照片意思時，使用者須自行判斷是否接受；另外兩項都把局部經驗推得太遠。
dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「修圖工具幫我調亮照片很方便；但我照着它的建議刪掉重要背景，照片的意思也變了。」你如何回應較貼切？

speaking.en: A navigation app can be a brilliant servant, but a poor master if drivers follow it past a clear road-closure sign.
speaking.zh: 導航程式能提供協助；但若司機無視清楚的封路路牌而盲從它，程式便由出色的僕人變成拙劣的主人。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再指出司機應在哪裏自行判斷。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：校報編輯用寫作工具修正文法，節省校對時間；工具卻建議刪去受訪者一段重要引述。編輯檢查建議後保留引述，自行決定文章重點。用一至兩句英文說明這個平衡。
writing.selfCheckZh: 指出工具修正文法的幫助、刪去重要引述的問題，以及編輯核對建議並保留引述的自主決定；不要把工具說成全無用處。

examples.en: The editing tool can be a brilliant servant, but a poor master: it corrected grammar, yet the school editors kept an important quote after reviewing its suggestion.
examples.zh: 編輯工具可以是出色的僕人，卻是拙劣的主人：它修正文法，但校報編輯核對建議後，仍保留一段重要引述。

examples.en: The school editors used software to fix grammar, but rejected its suggestion to remove an important quote; they showed that it can be a brilliant servant, but a poor master when allowed to decide what matters.
examples.zh: 校報編輯用軟件修正文法，卻拒絕它刪去重要引述的建議；他們表明，工具若獲准決定文章重點，就可能由出色的僕人變成拙劣的主人。

takeaways.en: As a tool, technology is a brilliant servant, but a poor master if it replaces a person’s judgment.
takeaways.zh: 科技可成為出色的僕人，但若取代人的判斷，便是拙劣的主人。

takeaways.en: Money can be a good servant, but a poor master when saving begins to crowd out time with family.
takeaways.zh: 儲蓄若開始擠掉與家人相處的時間，金錢便可能由好僕人變成差主人。

brief.meaningEn: Control a person’s daily choices or routine instead of merely assisting them.
brief.meaningZh: 主導某人的日常安排或選擇，而不只是提供協助。
brief.grammar: Pattern: X runs/ran/is running someone’s life. The subject is an app, schedule, habit or demand; the possessive identifies whose choices are being dictated.
brief.register: Figurative criticism: a friend or counsellor tells someone that an app, schedule or habit has begun dictating everyday decisions instead of serving the person.
brief.boundaryZh: 重點是控制日常選擇；日程表提供提醒或有人主持活動，不等於 running someone’s life。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不要誤把 run 解作真的奔跑；也不要因任何規律生活就斷定失去自主權。
brief.outcomeZh: 能指出哪項外在安排如何左右人的具體日常選擇。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 27, row 7; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: The schedule ended up running their life.

listening.en: At first, the fitness tracker helped Eli remember walks. Then he began cancelling family visits whenever it ordered another workout. The alerts were running his life.
listening.zh: 起初，健身追蹤器幫艾利記得散步；後來它一提醒多做運動，他便取消探望家人的安排。那些提示逐漸主導了他的生活。
listening.promptZh: 為何說提示 were running his life？

options.en: He let the alerts override his own family plans.
options.zh: 他讓提示凌駕自己原有的家庭安排。

options.en: He used the tracker to count his walks while choosing the rest of his day.
options.zh: 他用追蹤器計算步數，其他日常安排仍由自己決定。

options.en: He changed the device settings after noticing a problem.
options.zh: 他發現問題後更改了裝置設定。

options.en: He enjoyed a regular exercise routine without cancelling plans.
options.zh: 他享受規律運動，沒有取消原有安排。

listening.explanationZh: 提示令他取消家庭探訪，已在左右日常決定；單純記錄運動或保留自主選擇不同。

reply.promptEn: What changed when Eli began following every fitness alert instead of choosing his own schedule?
reply.promptZh: （艾利不再自行安排時間，而是遵從每項健身提示後，有甚麼改變？）

options.en: He started moving family visits to make room for extra workouts.
options.zh: 他開始改動探望家人的安排，騰出時間多做運動。

options.en: His daily plans were shaped by the device rather than by his own priorities.
options.zh: 他的每日計劃由裝置而非自己的優先次序決定。

options.en: The tracker began running his life by deciding when he could see his family.
options.zh: 追蹤器開始主導他的生活，甚至決定他何時能見家人。

options.en: He let exercise notifications interrupt plans he had made with others.
options.zh: 他讓運動通知打斷與別人約好的安排。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都描述提示主導生活後的具體改變；金句直指裝置取代他的日常選擇。

options.en: The schedule is running her life rather than simply helping her remember meetings.
options.zh: 日程表在主導她的生活，而不只是幫她記得開會。

options.en: The schedule is useful because it sends meeting reminders she can ignore or change.
options.zh: 日程表只提供她可忽略或更改的會議提醒，因此很有用。

options.en: She has chosen a fixed dinner time but can adjust the app whenever needed.
options.zh: 她自行訂下固定晚餐時間，仍可隨時調整程式。

scene.explanationZh: 程式建議已凌駕她與家人的安排，顯示主導日常選擇；可自行忽略或調整的提醒只是協助。
scene.promptZh: 某人原本只用日程程式提醒開會，後來連與家人吃飯也必須按程式建議改期，否則便感到不能拒絕。哪句最貼切？

options.en: A person misses family events repeatedly to obey an app’s alerts.
options.zh: 某人反覆因遵從程式提示而錯過家庭活動。

options.en: A person sets reminders and freely changes them when priorities shift.
options.zh: 某人設定提醒，優先次序改變時仍可自由調整。

options.en: A person lets a tracker decide meals and refuses invitations that conflict with it.
options.zh: 某人讓追蹤器決定膳食，並拒絕與其安排衝突的邀約。

contrast.explanationZh: 提醒仍受本人控制，不能說工具主導生活；另外兩項都顯示日常選擇受工具支配。
contrast.promptZh: 哪個情況最不適合說某個工具 is running their life？

options.en: It sounds as if the tracker is running your life; perhaps adjust the alerts so you can keep your plans.
options.zh: 聽起來追蹤器正在主導你的生活；或許可調整提示，保留與朋友的安排。

options.en: You should keep every tracker goal even when it regularly disrupts friendships.
options.zh: 即使目標經常影響友誼，你仍應遵從追蹤器每項要求。

options.en: The tracker is only recording numbers, so it cannot affect your choices.
options.zh: 追蹤器只是記錄數字，所以不可能影響你的選擇。

dialogue.explanationZh: 朋友已多次為目標取消約會，顯示工具開始主導生活；調整提示比盲從或否認影響更合適。
dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「我為了追蹤器目標，已經幾次臨時取消跟朋友的晚餐。」你怎樣回應較貼切？

speaking.en: The study timetable was running her life when she stopped seeing friends just to satisfy every reminder.
speaking.zh: 她為了遵從每項提醒而不再見朋友時，溫習時間表已在主導她的生活。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再指出哪種日常選擇被時間表取代。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：一名學生的音樂練習程式在家庭晚飯時不斷發任務；她每次都立即練習，常錯過與家人用餐。她其後關掉用餐時的通知，自行決定練習時間。用一至兩句英文描述問題及改善。
writing.selfCheckZh: 指出程式通知令她常錯過家庭晚飯，並說出關掉用餐時通知、恢復自行安排練習；不要把一般提醒本身當成問題。

examples.en: The practice app was running her life when its dinner-time tasks kept her away from family meals; she turned off those alerts and chose her own practice hours.
examples.zh: 練習程式在晚飯時發任務，令她常錯過與家人用餐，當時已主導她的生活；她關掉那些通知，改由自己決定練習時間。

examples.en: She realised the app was running her life because she always obeyed its dinner alerts instead of eating with her family, so she reset the schedule and practised later.
examples.zh: 她每次都遵從用餐時的提示，不跟家人吃飯，才發現程式主導了生活；於是她重設時間表，改在稍後練習。

takeaways.en: The reminder app began running his life when it replaced choices he wanted to make himself.
takeaways.zh: 提醒程式取代了他原本想自行作出的決定時，便開始主導他的生活。

takeaways.en: A timetable can help, but it should not end up running your life.
takeaways.zh: 時間表可以幫忙，但不應最終主導你的生活。
